data.content_ref: inline:The pack exhibits a foundational ambiguity between two logically distinct pricing models — continuous pro-rata (SRC_002's $2/7 per pencil, infinitely divisible) and discrete bundle-only (SCR_001's strict $2-per-7-lot) — that are COMPATIBLE WITH each other only at exact multiples of 7, a condition 21 happens to satisfy. This compatibility is contingent, not necessary: it INHERITS a coincidence of the problem's construction. Refuted if the problem is reposed with a non-multiple quantity (e.g., 10 pencils) and both models still yield the same cost, which would collapse the distinction and show a single shared mechanism rather than two compatible-but-distinct ones.
